newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Gul Tech gets nod for high-end circuit boards.
newsitem.headline: Gul Tech gets nod for high-end circuit boards.

text.p: Gul Technologies Singapore Ltd has obtained rights to produce high density printed circuit boards (PCBs) from a Hewlett-Packard unit, Gul Technologies said on Tuesday.
The circuit board manufacturer said in a statement the use of DYCOstrate technology will meet market demand for small end products which are high on performance.
Hewlett-Packard GmbH in Boeblingen, Gernmany, was one of the first licensees of the technology, it said.
The technology, using plasma etching to produce very fine diametre holes in PCBs and interconnect products, can be applied in telecommunications, mobile communication and computers.
Gul Tech is a unit of Singapore mainboard-listed diversified group Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd.
Gul Tech received in-principle approval last month to launch its initial public offering on Singapore's second board, SESDAQ.
